read.thesis: Orders up 9% with backlog $7.9B (book-to-bill 1.13) and FY sales guide held at 5.5%, but China now seen down low single digits and sales growth leans on H2 backlog conversion.

triggers.label: Orders up 9%, four quarters strong
triggers.quote: Robust demand continued in the first quarter, with underlying orders growth of 9%.

triggers.label: Backlog $7.9B, up 9%
triggers.quote: Our backlog ended the quarter at $7.9 billion, up 9% year over year, and our book-to-bill was 1.13.

triggers.label: Price contributed 3 points
triggers.quote: Price contributed three points to growth as expected.

triggers.label: China orders down high single digits
triggers.quote: China was down high single digits in the quarter from an orders perspective.

triggers.label: China outlook cut to low single-digit decline
triggers.quote: We now believe that we'll be down low single digits for the year.

guidance.quote: We are reiterating our guidance of 5.5% sales growth, 4% underlying sales growth
an adjusted segment EBITDA margin of approximately 28%
We are raising the bottom and midpoint of our adjusted EPS guide and now expect $6.4 to $6.55 per share.
positioning us well for our expected full-year growth of approximately 10% at greater than 18% margin
We are guiding our Q2 2026 adjusted EPS at $1.5 to $1.55.
We expect adjusted segment EBITDA margin of approximately 27%
still expect to return approximately $2.2 billion to shareholders through $1.2 billion in dividends and $1 billion of share repurchase

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY2026 sales growth and margin guidance
prior_guidance_check.quote: We are reiterating our guidance of 5.5% sales growth, 4% underlying sales growth

red_flags.label: China orders down high single digits, outlook cut to low-single-digit decline
red_flags.quote: We now believe that we'll be down low single digits for the year.

red_flags.label: Q2 margin guide ~27% and software renewal drag
red_flags.quote: The lower volume from renewals in the Total Energy Energies deal impacts Emerson Electric Co.'s adjusted segment EBITDA margin by approximately 150 basis points

evasions.quote: it will be another softer quarter in Q2, and that will be largely behind us.
